description: BeReal-style demand for real, unpolished content shows appetite for low-pressure formats Journeys is built around.
Instagram itself is de-emphasizing the curated photo grid in favor of video and informal sharing, opening a lane for off-grid formats.
A large and growing creator economy provides a supply of how-to and progress content that Journeys can host and reward.
Documented move toward Stories, DMs and Close Friends matches Journeys' off-grid, opt-in audience model.

item: High-intent moments leaking to AI / search
description: Inspiration-to-action moments increasingly go to Google, YouTube, Reddit and AI assistants, a strategic gap Journeys aims to capture.

Instagram is moving Highlights off prime under-bio real estate (2024-25), demoting the incumbent archive - which opens the lane for a better progress format and makes the Highlight-to-Journey conversion on-ramp timely.

Users are saturated with prompts; a format that nags risks rejection. Journeys mitigates structurally: posting reminders are off by default, and on the viewing side followers opt in to 'follow along' a specific Journey, so they are never bombarded with every creator's updates - they only receive the journeys they chose.
Stories, Reels, Notes, Threads and Broadcast Channels already compete for posting attention; another format must justify its slot.
Falling public/original posting is also a risk: fewer people share publicly at all, shrinking the top of the funnel.

New social formats fail when early creators post into an empty audience. Journeys mitigates with a seeded launch: Meta partners with established Instagram communities and creators to define the format and generate early interest, and Journeys are pushed not only to a creator's own followers but also out to broad, relevant interest communities - so a beginner is found by others at the same stage rather than posting into an empty room.
Journeys requires an ongoing posting habit, a higher commitment than a one-off post; sustaining it is unproven.

Direct in-Meta precedent: even low-effort Story Highlights are widely abandoned and Instagram deletes neglected ones - evidence that a progress-collection habit decays, which Journeys' higher-effort posting must actively overcome.
Instagram engagement fell ~26% YoY (7.3% to 5.4%); incremental value must come from a genuinely new behavior, not from competing for shrinking feed attention.
